title: Ok, after much work, I think I'm almost ready to give this it's own domain.
author: DuchessCupcakeGames
selftext:
I've been wiring tirelessly at getting this RPG to actually play like how I envisioned it. With some valuable recommendations and advice from this group, I think it's almost ready for me to purchase a domain name and call it a game. 

So far, Ferality has 85 maps, 5 faction narratives and story arcs, NPC story arcs that you can either hire or battle for their equipment, a thorough battle system with full on RPG math. Quests that back the main storyline, 8 different "Kindred" characters each with special abilities that effect how the game is played, all that fun rpg stuff.

With suggestions from this group, I've cut out the LLM hallucination language where it was mixing the game tone with the user interface too much, and animated each of the Kindred types so it's not just a floating picture of the avatar, even though it was originally text based. 

All those changes really made a difference. Thank you. I'm open and welcoming any feedback to improve it further. Thanks for your time ❤️

For anyone that wants to take a look, it's at ferality.lovable.app until I get a more permanent domain.

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body:
The constant resizing of frames is jarring, you should try to make those fixed. 

It also suffers from AI loving to put way too much text and details. This makes your menus overwhelming. Like, every button does not need an explanation under it. Some things are obvious or easy to learn.

replies.author: DuchessCupcakeGames
replies.body: Thank you, that helps. I don't see things kind this because I'm coming from the place of wanting people understand the game, but maybe defaulting to not having the tutorial on or having it explain less or a combination of both is in order. I have the players handbook for anyone that wants to go deeper with all that stuff so it's not necessary to be so up front. That makes sense.
